fields.description: Shown to the user answering the question, e.g. "Yes", "Wholesale", "Tamil Nadu".
fields.label: Answer

fields.description: Internal key used to match this answer against a follow-up question's "Only when answer is".
fields.label: Answer Key

fields.description: Value written to the target field when this answer is chosen. Leave empty for an answer that only triggers a follow-up question and should not change the field itself (e.g. an "SEZ: No" that should leave whatever the previous question set).
fields.label: Assigned Value

fields.description: Pre-selects this answer. If it is the only enabled answer, the question is answered automatically and not shown.
fields.label: Default
